abstract: When inundated with numerous specimens of products of conception as the consequence of miscarriage, it is all too easy for histopathologists to forget that the biology of trophoblast and the events of early placental implantation continue to fascinate because of the inherently invasive properties of the non-villous (extravillous) trophoblast. However, unlike the invasion of a malignant tumour, the invasion of trophoblast is controlled. The failure of adequate conversion of maternal uteroplacental arteries is a major pathogenetic phenomenon of important disorders of pregnancy including pre-eclampsia. However, it is in the field of gestational trophoblastic disease that diagnostic acumen is most called for. There are several problematic areas that give rise to diagnostic error; e.g., the diagnosis of early complete mole as partial mole, the over-diagnosis of hydatidiform mole in tubal pregnancy and the diagnosis of placental site non-villous trophoblast as placental site trophoblastic tumour or choriocarcinoma, particularly if associated with atypia, as frequently observed in complete mole. The chorionic villi of early diploid complete mole show characteristic features of villous profile, stromal mucin and stromal nuclear debris. The distinction between complete mole and triploid partial mole can be facilitated by ploidy analysis and immunohistochemistry for the product of the paternally imprinted, maternally expressed gene, p57kip2. Persistent trophoblastic disease (PTD) is a clinical not a histopathological diagnosis and the role of the histopathologist once a diagnosis of PTD has been made is limited. Invasive mole and choriocarcinoma are encompassed by PTD. Tumours of the non-villous trophoblast are placental site trophoblastic tumour and the more recently recognised epithelioid trophoblastic tumour. The role of immunohistochemistry in the elucidation of trophoblastic lesions is discussed pragmatically.
abstract_ja: 流産の結果として妊娠産物の検体が大量に提出されるとき、病理医は、非絨毛（絨毛外）栄養膜細胞が本来もつ浸潤性の性質が今なお興味深い生物学的課題であることを、つい忘れてしまいがちです。しかし、悪性腫瘍の浸潤とは異なり、栄養膜の浸潤は制御されています。母体子宮胎盤動脈の適切なリモデリングの不全は、子癇前症を含む重要な妊娠障害の病態機序です。しかし、診断の的確さが最も求められるのは妊娠性絨毛性疾患の領域です。診断誤りを生じやすい問題領域がいくつかあります。例えば、早期の全胞状奇胎を部分胞状奇胎と診断すること、子宮外妊娠での胞状奇胎の過剰診断、そして、特に全胞状奇胎によく見られるような異型を伴う場合に、胎盤部非絨毛性栄養膜細胞を胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍または絨毛癌と診断することです。早期の二倍体全胞状奇胎の絨毛は、特徴的な絨毛形態、間質のムチン、間質の核片を示します。全胞状奇胎と三倍体部分胞状奇胎の区別は、倍数性解析と、父性刷り込みを受け母性発現する遺伝子であるp57kip2産物の免疫組織化学によって容易になりえます。持続性トロホブラスト病（PTD）は臨床的診断であり、病理組織学的診断ではありません。PTDと診断された後の病理医の役割は限られています。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌はPTDに包含されます。非絨毛性栄養膜の腫瘍は、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と、より最近認識された類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍です。トロホブラスト病変の解明における免疫組織化学の役割を実践的に論じます。
